title: LinkAge Plus
intro: A programme of classes, activities and workshops for people aged 50 and over who live in Tower Hamlets.

blocks.heading: Activities and support
paragraphs: Join gentle exercise, yoga, line dancing, tai chi, social activities, singing, arts and crafts, healthy living workshops, digital support and community celebrations. Most sessions are free or low-cost.

blocks.heading: Five community hubs
paragraphs: Activities are hosted at Toynbee Hall Community Centre, Sundial Centre, Age UK East London, Sonali Gardens and Neighbours in Poplar. Check the current timetable before visiting.

blocks.heading: Toynbee Hall Community Centre
paragraphs: 28 Commercial Street, London E1 6LS. Call 0203 856 9721 or email linkageplus@toynbeehall.org.uk. Many activities are drop-in. Professionals can contact the team about referring someone.
